decisive_items: cystoid mass with a stalk attached to the nasal pars plana
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells
response.rationale: Ciliary body location with stalked cystoid mass, myxoid spindle/stellate histology, and S100/GFAP positivity are most specific for medulloepithelioma; neuroepithelial tumor is a broader category and neurofibroma lacks GFAP and the stalked ciliary body architecture.

rejected.why: Broad category; lacks the stalked ciliary body cystoid and myxoid spindle/stellate histology that specifically characterize medulloepithelioma.
S100 and myxoid spindle cells overlap, but patchy GFAP positivity and the ciliary body stalk/cystoid mass are not features of neurofibroma.
